results.title: Gov’t pays 52,000 teachers’ promotion arrears, 28,000 pending
results.content: The government has paid the promotion salary arrears of 52,000 teachers, with payments for the remaining 28,000 still outstanding, the Education Minister, Haruna Iddrisu, has disclosed.

results.title: Jamestown fishermen threaten demo over delayed operationalisation of cold store
results.content: Some fishermen at the Jamestown Fishing Harbour have threatened to stage a protest if the cold storage facility at the harbour is not operational by December 31, 2026.

results.title: Oklahoma City Swingman exits on stretcher following gruesome leg injury
results.content: The Thunder guard was fouled in a back-and-forth game against the Clippers with less than two minutes to go in the final period.

results.title: Ghana needs TRUST laws to stop the theft of its Children’s Inheritance
results.content: Imagine this: a twenty-five-year-old in Labadi watches strangers build mansions on land his ancestors preserved. His community’s custodians disposed of it. The proceeds bought cars, funded extravagance and disappeared. He cannot afford a plot. His children will inherit stories about land that should have secured their future. Elsewhere, galamsey swallows a girl’s family farm and poisons their river. Others take the gold. She inherits devastation.

results.title: Ghana faces possible US$50 million default judgment at ECOWAS Court over alleged human rights violations
results.content: A Singaporean businessman, Toh You Kang, has asked the ECOWAS Community Court of Justice to award him the cedi equivalent of US$50 million over alleged violations of his fundamental human rights by the Republic of Ghana. Mr You Kang, an investor and shareholder of Ghanaian-registered NSG Innovation Limited, has also asked the court to declare that Ghana violated his rights to liberty, security, freedom from arbitrary arrest and detention, fair hearing, equality before the law and freedom of movement.

results.title: Ebola fight: Misinformation is our worst enemy — GHS boss
results.content: The Director-General of the Ghana Health Service (GHS), Dr Samuel Kaba Akoriyea, has warned that misinformation could undermine Ghana’s efforts to prepare for a possible Ebola outbreak, urging journalists and social media users to verify information before publishing or sharing it.

results.title: Meghan to co-host Junior MasterChef Australia
results.content: The Duchess of Sussex has been confirmed as a co-hostof the new season of Junior MasterChef Australia.

results.title: Awula Serwah urges Mahama to reaffirm mining licence requirements
results.content: The Executive Director of Eco-Conscious Citizens, Awula Serwah, has urged President John Dramani Mahama to publicly reaffirm the legal requirements governing mining, warning that recent comments by Ghana Gold Board Chief Executive Officer Sammy Gyamfi risk sending the wrong signal to small-scale miners.

results.title: Cheaper DStv: 4 new packages take effect November 5
results.content: Canal+ and MultiChoice Ghana have introduced cheaper DStv subscription packages as part of efforts to make pay television more affordable and discourage the use of pirated services and illegal digital boxes.

results.title: UCC-UTAG demands clearer boundaries for GTEC’s regulatory role
results.content: The University of Cape Coast (UCC) Chapter of the University Teachers Association of Ghana (UTAG) has admonished the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) to refrain from interfering in university affairs and focus on its core mandates.

results.title: TOR unveils a sweeping four-year transformation agenda
results.content: The Tema Oil Refinery (TOR) has announced a sweeping four-year transformation agenda to quadruple its refining footprint, diversify its asset base, and embed social infrastructure in its revival story.

results.title: SAWA Program: Agri-Impact, PwC Ghana partner to strengthen consortium firms
results.content: Agri-Impact Ltd has signed a four-year agreement with PwC Ghana to strengthen the institutional capacity of consortium partners implementing the Sustainable Aquaculture for Women Advancement (SAWA) Program.

results.title: Tarkwa Nsuaem NDC Elections: Incumbent Chairman, Secretary lose seats
results.content: John Justice Abban, the 2020 Parliament Candidate for the National Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Tarkwa Nsuaem Constituency, has defeated Mr Danladi Salifu, the party’s incumbent constituency chairman, at the party’s constituency executives’ election held at the weekend.

results.title: North- East Region turns to solar-powered water system to tackle climate change
results.content: The North-East Regional Coordinating Council is promoting solar-powered water systems and dry-season farming to help communities adapt to climate change, as rivers dry up and traditional sources of irrigation become increasingly unreliable.

results.title: Ellembelle NDC Chairman-elect poised to unite members ahead of 2028 victory
results.content: Shaibu Dauda Abdulai, the Ellembelle National Democratic Congress (NDC) Constituency Chairman-elect, has pledged to unite and reconcile party faithful to retain the party in power in December 2028.

results.title: Ghana explores AI to predict Ebola and other health threats — GHS
results.content: The Ghana Health Service (GHS) is exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to help anticipate disease outbreaks and strengthen emergency planning as the country steps up preparations against the threat of Ebola.

results.title: Refining Ghanaian crude in Ghana keeps value onshore – TOR MD
results.content: Edmond Kombat, the Managing Director (MD) of the Tema Oil Refinery (TOR), has underscored the strategic importance of refining Ghanaian crude oil domestically, describing it as a critical step toward retaining value within the national economy and fulfilling the President’s vision for value addition.

results.title: Your past prescriptions haven’t helped developing countries – TOR MD tells IMF
results.content: Edmond Kombat, the Managing Director of the Tema Oil Refinery Limited (TOR), has challenged the International Monetary Fund (IMF) over its long-standing prescriptions for state-owned enterprises.

results.title: Ghana activates Ebola preparedness system, conducts simulation exercises — GHS
results.content: The Ghana Health Service (GHS) says it has activated its preparedness arrangements for Ebola and conducted simulation exercises as part of efforts to strengthen the country's ability to respond to a possible outbreak.

results.title: Ebola: Ghana has not dropped the ball on disease screening – Prof Amuasi
results.content: Prof John Amuasi, Leader of Global Health at the KCCR, has rejected suggestions that Ghana has let its disease screening systems slip since the COVID-19 pandemic.

results.title: CDABI president launches two books on digital asset regulation
results.content: President of the Chamber of Digital Assets and Blockchain Innovations (CDABI), Ghana Chapter, Dr Caleb Kwaku Afaglo, has launched two books on digital asset regulation to inform policy decisions and industry development in Ghana and West Africa.

results.title: Telecel Foundation equips 100 hearing-impaired students with practical STEM skills
results.content: The Telecel Foundation extended its commitment to inclusive learning to the Volta School for the Deaf in Hohoe, Volta Region

results.title: Obuasi SHTS abuse allegations: WILI demands independent probe, protection for students
results.content: Women in Leadership International (WILI) has called for a thorough, independent investigation into allegations of sexual abuse involving female students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School.

results.title: Upper East specialists seek urgent equipment boost as GMTF eases cancer care costs
results.content: Medical specialists in the Upper East Region have called for the swift delivery of diagnostic equipment to complement the financial relief provided by the Ghana Medical Trust Fund (GMTF).

results.title: TOR slashes debt from $650m to $300m, MD reveals
results.content: The Tema Oil Refinery (TOR) has reduced its debt burden from $650 million to about $300 million under a restructuring programme supported by the Energy Sector Levies Act (ESLA), Mr Edmond Kombat, Managing Director (MD) of TOR, has announced.

results.title: ‘Ghana was very high risk, but we were fortunate’ – Prof Amuasi on 2014–15 Ebola outbreak
results.content: Ghana faced a very high risk of Ebola during the 2014–15 West African outbreak, despite recording no cases, Global Health Leader at the KCCR, Prof John Amuasi, has said.

results.title: Will the public change its mind about Meghan?
results.content: The allegations of sexual abuse against Thomas Markle have put his daughter Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, under an uncomfortable spotlight.

results.title: Machete-wielding mob attacks health workers responding to Ebola in Congo
results.content: Angry youths armed with machetes attacked two community health workers raising ​awareness about the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, killing one and wounding the other, according to officials and ‌a memo seen by Reuters on Monday,

results.title: Ghana cannot PCR-test every arriving passenger for Ebola – Prof Amuasi
results.content: Ghana cannot PCR-test every arriving passenger for Ebola, Prof John Amuasi said. He wants accurate passenger records and reliable follow-up to be central to the country’s response.

results.title: ‘The single most important thing’ is accurate passenger data – Prof Amuasi on Ebola preparedness
results.content: Ghana must prioritise accurate passenger information to strengthen its Ebola preparedness, Prof John Amuasi, KCCR's Global Health Lead, said.
